note: Access tier decides what twinos can do: open = fetchable after a yes; registered = free account and click-through first, so the owner downloads it; controlled = an institution's data access committee must approve, so twinos never fetches it. redistribute=false means only aggregates and release fingerprints may leave this PC.

datasets.name: depmap-crispr-gene-effect
datasets.title: DepMap 26Q1 CRISPR gene effect (Chronos)
datasets.measures: CRISPR knockout gene-effect scores per cancer cell line
datasets.use: Which genes a cancer cell line needs to survive: a hypothesis layer for candidate targets.

datasets.name: biogrid-orcs
datasets.title: BioGRID ORCS v2.0.18 CRISPR screens
datasets.use: Cross-checking a candidate target against screens others have published.

datasets.name: forecast-editing-outcomes
datasets.title: FORECasT CRISPR repair outcomes
datasets.measures: Sequenced indel outcomes of Cas9 edits at thousands of target sites
datasets.use: What an edit at a site actually produces, measured: the evidence behind predicted edit outcomes.

datasets.name: indelphi-editing-outcomes
datasets.title: inDelphi CRISPR repair outcomes
datasets.measures: Sequenced indel outcomes of Cas9 edits
datasets.use: A second measured source of edit outcomes, for comparison with FORECasT.

datasets.name: gdc-tcga-open-mutations
datasets.title: TCGA open masked somatic mutations (GDC)
datasets.use: What mutations a cancer type carries, as a comparison set. Pre-treatment only, so not before/after.

datasets.name: geo-gse91061-melanoma-nivolumab
datasets.title: Riaz 2017 melanoma, nivolumab (GEO GSE91061)
datasets.subjects: 65 patients, 109 samples (51 pre-treatment, 58 on-treatment), with response labels
datasets.use: A true before/after set: what changed in responders versus non-responders during treatment.

datasets.name: geo-gse192341-breast-neoadjuvant
datasets.title: Neoadjuvant breast cancer pairs (GEO GSE192341)
datasets.measures: RNA expression, with exomes for the pairs
datasets.use: Before/after pairs across chemotherapy in breast cancer.

datasets.name: geo-gse240671-breast-neoadjuvant
datasets.title: Neoadjuvant breast cancer, non-responders resequenced (GEO GSE240671)
datasets.use: What persists in tumours that did not respond.

datasets.name: aacr-genie
datasets.title: AACR Project GENIE 19.0-public (with BPC outcomes)
datasets.measures: Targeted gene panels; BPC cohorts add treatment, progression-free and overall survival
datasets.license: GENIE terms: no re-identification, no redistribution without AACR permission
datasets.use: Mutation frequencies and, in BPC, outcomes. Local analysis only: publish aggregates, never rows.

datasets.name: msk-chord
datasets.title: MSK-CHORD (cBioPortal)
datasets.measures: Gene panels plus treatment and survival
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (no commercial use, no derivatives)
datasets.use: Treatment and survival context. No derivatives, so local reading only.

datasets.name: tracerx-421
datasets.title: TRACERx 421 (lung, multi-region plus serial ctDNA)
datasets.measures: Whole exomes, multi-region, serial circulating tumour DNA
datasets.license: EGA, TRACERx committee approval and signed agreement
datasets.use: The best longitudinal set in the report. Needs an institution; twinos will not fetch it.

datasets.name: hartwig-metastatic
datasets.title: Hartwig Medical Foundation metastatic whole genomes
datasets.measures: Whole genomes with treatment and outcome data
datasets.use: Post-treatment metastatic genomes. Needs an institution; twinos will not fetch it.

datasets.name: pog570
datasets.title: POG570 Personalized OncoGenomics (metastatic)
datasets.measures: Processed variants and expression (raw reads controlled)
datasets.use: What metastatic, mostly pre-treated cancers carry. One biopsy each, so not true pairs.
